Project.Name: Project_Schedule_v7
Project.Title: Development and Deployment of a Music Streaming Platform
Project.Author: Trần Hiếu

Task.Name: Development and Deployment of a Music Streaming Platform
Music Streaming Platform
Requirements and Planning
Hold the kickoff and elicitation meetings with the Sponsor and Customer and develop the Project Charter
Task.Notes: A-01: assumes the Sponsor and the Customer are available for the kickoff and elicitation meetings on these dates.

Task.Name: Write the Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
Build the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and acceptance criteria
Write the Project Scope Statement, WBS and WBS Dictionary
Research target users and competing apps
Review the SRS, RTM and scope baseline with the Customer and Sponsor
Task.Notes: A-02: assumes the Customer and the Sponsor are available for the review on these dates. Lag 2 days after 1.1.2-1.1.4: the documents are sent in advance so they can read them.

Task.Name: Revise the SRS and RTM for Customer sign-off
SRS and RTM signed off by the Customer (milestone)
Task.Notes: A-03: assumes the Customer signs off on this date. Lag 1 day after 1.1.7: the Customer checks the revised SRS and RTM.

Task.Name: System and Database Design
Evaluate the technology stack and design the system architecture
Design the ER diagram and PostgreSQL schema
Design the wireframes
Design the high-fidelity mockups and clickable prototype
Write the detailed design (modules, class and sequence diagrams)
Define the general API specification (OpenAPI 3.0) shared by all developers
Set up the repository, CI/CD pipeline, staging, backups and CDN
Task.Notes: A-14: assumes the cloud/CDN provider activates the accounts within 2 working days of the purchase (lag 2 days after 1.7.3).

Task.Name: Review the system design and mockups with the Customer
Task.Notes: A-05: assumes the Customer is available for the design review on these dates. Lag 2 days after 1.2.6 and 1.2.4: the design package is sent in advance.

Task.Name: Revise the mockups and prototype
Revise the system design and API specification
System design approved by the Customer (milestone)
Task.Notes: A-05: assumes the Customer approves the revised design on this date (lag 1 day after 1.2.9 and 1.2.10).

Task.Name: MVP Development
Develop the authentication and user API with unit tests
Develop the music streaming API and CDN integration with unit tests
Develop the Live Premiere WebSocket service with unit tests
Build the playback and Live Premiere screens with unit tests
Test the MVP functions (integration testing)
Demo the MVP to the Customer
Task.Notes: A-06: assumes the Customer is available for the MVP demo on this date.

Task.Name: Fix MVP defects and demo feedback
MVP features completed internally (milestone)
Full Feature Development
Develop search, playlist, library and recommendation APIs with unit tests
Develop favorites, comments, notification, admin and receipt-verification APIs with unit tests
Build login, profile, search, playlist, library and social screens with unit tests
Build offline download, video playback, in-app purchase and admin dashboard screens with unit tests
Test the full feature set (integration testing)
Demo all functions to the Customer and Sponsor
Task.Notes: A-07: assumes the Customer and the Sponsor are available for the demo on this date.

Task.Name: Fix feature defects and demo feedback
All functions complete (milestone)
Testing and QA
Write the test plan and quality metrics
Create the test case template and write the test cases from the RTM
Run load (9,000-15,000 users), security and device performance tests
Fix the defects found in load, security and device testing
Write the test summary report
Review the test summary report with the Customer
Task.Notes: A-08: assumes the Customer is available for the test report review on this date. Lag 2 days after 1.5.5: the report is sent in advance.

Task.Name: Fix the defects raised in the test review
Release candidate ready for Customer acceptance testing (milestone)
Deployment and Closeout
Deploy the release candidate to staging
Fix the defects reported by the Customer during UAT
Task.Notes: A-09: assumes the Customer performs UAT on staging during the lag after 1.6.1 and while the defects are fixed.

Task.Name: Customer acceptance sign-off after UAT (milestone)
Task.Notes: A-09: assumes the Customer finishes UAT and signs acceptance on this date (lag 1 day after 1.6.2 to retest the fixes).

Task.Name: Deploy to production with monitoring and backups
Provide post-release hypercare
Submit the apps to the App Store and Google Play
Train the Customer administrators
Task.Notes: A-10: assumes the Customer administrators are available for the training on these dates.

Task.Name: Write the user guide, admin guide and release notes (Vietnamese/English)
Write the deployment and operations documentation
Review the handover deliverables with the Customer
Task.Notes: A-11: assumes the Customer is available for the handover review on these dates. Lag 2 days after 1.6.8 and 1.6.9: the documents are sent in advance.

Task.Name: Revise the handover documents
Apps published and deliverables handed over (milestone)
Task.Notes: A-11, A-13: assumes the Customer accepts the handover on this date and the App Store / Google Play review takes at most 3 working days (lag 3 days after 1.6.6).

Task.Name: Project Management
Develop the Project Management Plan (schedule, cost baseline, risk, quality, communications and procurement plans)
Project Management Plan approved by the Sponsor (milestone)
Task.Notes: A-04: assumes the Sponsor reviews the plan during the 2-day lag and approves it on this date.

Task.Name: Procure the cloud, CDN, test devices and test tools
Track progress and send status and cost reports to the Sponsor
Monitor risks and manage change requests
Collect lessons learned and write the final project report
Review the final project report with the Sponsor
Task.Notes: A-12: assumes the Sponsor is available for the final report review on this date. Lag 2 days after 1.7.6: the report is sent in advance.

Task.Name: Revise the final report and close the project
Project closed with Sponsor sign-off (milestone)
Task.Notes: A-12: assumes the Sponsor signs off the project closure on this date.
